notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Haywire Mite from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Haywire Mite enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
